newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 800 bln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 800 bln won to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to supply 800 billion won to the local banking system on Wednesday through repurchase agreements maturing on Friday, an official at the central bank said.
"The bank has decided to supply the money as cash as liquidity is expected to tighten today," said the official.
He said the national treasury was due to absorb about one trillion won through tax payments on Wednesday.
"I expect the fund supply will help prevent the short-term cash liquidity from rapidly drying up," the official said.
